Rigged from the one owner-authorized Family-A stride source, art/staging/thad/profile-stride-01.png (ledger asset thad-profile-walk-continuity, attempt 1/1), so this walk and thad-stand-right are one drawing of one man (docs/52). SECOND CUT, same source, no image operation: Tyler saw the first cut gallop -- the rig added its sine to the source's own stride, so the legs opened and closed with the same leg leading every frame. --level-limbs measures each limb's source angle (near leg +21.8, far leg -19.9, far arm -13.9 from vertical) and takes it out, so the cycle swings hanging limbs about one hip column and the legs ALTERNATE; the planted sole is grounded on the cycle's own ground row so the head bobs (2.7% of height at the extremes) instead of the feet floating. Swing 1.5 (the source's own +/-21 degree stride), knee 0, chosen from levelled variants at 1.0, 1.3 and 1.5 on a sheet: the narrower cycles put him at 3-3.7 steps a second.
